main.model_selection: Best validation MSE for each new fit; routing fixed before training.
baseline_arms: Sangam CIL with point steering regression
candidate_arms: ordinal steering loss for turn branches; MSE of expected steering elsewhere
main.collection_and_tuning_scope: Training roads must remain spatially separated from all reserved evaluation roads.
main.termination_scope: Brake and end at the first control sample with absolute cross-track error greater than or equal to 7.0 m.

fork.model_selection: validation goal arrival count; tie-break on mean route progress and cross-track error
baseline_arms: Sangam CIL with point steering regression
candidate_arms: Sangam CIL with conditional Gaussian mixture
Sangam CIL with steering bins and residuals
Sangam CIL with squeeze-and-excitation in the CNN
fork.collection_and_tuning_scope: Sangam training and validation roads only. Road splits fixed from signed lane-link geometry before training.
fork.termination_scope: Brake and end at the first control sample with absolute cross-track error greater than or equal to 7.0 m.

arterials.model_selection: Select the trained output on frozen validation roads. Road choices precede new collection and candidate rollouts.
baseline_arms: Sangam CIL with point steering regression
arterials.collection_and_tuning_scope: Training roads must remain spatially separated from all reserved evaluation roads.
arterials.termination_scope: Brake and end at the first control sample with absolute cross-track error greater than or equal to 7.0 m.

confirmation.model_selection: Reuse the three locked main test policies without any training or decoder changes.
baseline_arms: Sangam CIL with point steering regression
confirmation.collection_and_tuning_scope: Training roads must remain spatially separated from all reserved evaluation roads.
confirmation.termination_scope: Brake and end at the first control sample with absolute cross-track error greater than or equal to 7.0 m.

metric_definitions.first_2p2m: Route station at first sample with absolute cross-track error at least 2.2 m, or terminal station if never reached.
metric_definitions.cte_stop: Stop on the first sample whose absolute cross-track error meets or exceeds 7.0 m, with zero throttle and full brake.
metric_definitions.terminal_progress: Route station at the final logged sample, even if stopped for a separate terminal condition.

telemetry.source: Selected columns without rounding for all newly recorded 7 m runs.
